newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Inventec to cut '97 forecast.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Inventec to cut '97 forecast.

text.p: Taiwan computer maker Inventec Corp said on Tuesday it planned to lower its 1997 pre-tax profit forecast due to slowing orders for notebook computers, but declined to estimate how much the forecast would be pared back.
"The company has decided to lower its pre-tax profit forecast for 1997, but the exact figure needs accountants' final approval," an Inventec spokeswoman said by telephone.
Word of the expected profit decline prompted investors to dump Inventec's shares in late Tuesday trade. With 70 minutes to go, Inventec plunged T$13 or 6.88 percent to T$176.
Inventec, one of Taiwan's leading makers of monitors and an emerging contender in notebook computers, had set a pre-tax profit forecast of T$52 billion.
The spokeswoman attributed the planned reduction to poorer-than-expected notebook computer orders.
Inventec would announce the profit forecast revision by June 20, she said.
